response.sql: WITH status_averages AS (SELECT rfistat, AVG(modindex) AS avg_modindex FROM signals WHERE modindex IS NOT NULL GROUP BY rfistat), overall_average AS (SELECT AVG(modindex) AS avg_modindex FROM signals WHERE modindex IS NOT NULL), qualifying AS (SELECT sa.rfistat, sa.avg_modindex, sa.avg_modindex - oa.avg_modindex AS above_average FROM status_averages AS sa CROSS JOIN overall_average AS oa WHERE sa.avg_modindex > oa.avg_modindex) SELECT rfistat, avg_modindex, above_average, avg_modindex - AVG(avg_modindex) OVER () AS difference_from_qualifying_mean FROM qualifying

assumptions.assumption: “Above average” compares each status’s average with the average across all signals that have a modulation index, giving each signal equal weight.

alternatives.interpretation: Compare each status’s average with the mean of all status averages, giving each status equal weight.
